title: Choose an Analytics metric
lead: Choose Analytics metrics by definition, unit and aggregation. Check how Dashboard labels, local presets and API fields differ.

blocks.text: Use Audience for viewing activity, Quality of Experience for startup and buffering, and Top Errors for failures. Compare quality values alongside their playback counts or viewing duration.
The table lists common metrics and API aggregation examples. Available Dashboard fields depend on the view, and collected fields depend on the collector.

rows: Sessions that displayed a first frame; differs from an unfiltered impression count.
Milliseconds. The Observability catalog also supports average and percentile; median is the default.
Total played milliseconds. Divide by 3,600,000 for hours.
Percentage of viewing time spent waiting for media. Distinct from average BUFFERED duration and the app’s local QoE calculation. Retain the corresponding Played duration.
Milliseconds, not a percentage. The Dashboard describes Buffering Time as an average per Play.
Bits/second (bps); divide by 1,000,000 for Mbps. Rendition bitrate rather than network throughput.
Segment-download speed in bits/second. Availability depends on the collector.
Percentage against sessions considered, including failures before video starts. Using successful Plays as its denominator would change the meaning.
Milliseconds for a seek to resume playback.

blocks.text: The official reference lists download bandwidth and downloaded-data limitations for AVFoundation and Bitmovin iOS. Treat an absent field or empty result as a support or data question, rather than zero.

items: count gives a count, sum a total, and avg an arithmetic mean. The metric defines what is counted or averaged.
median is the 50th percentile; p95 describes the slower tail. A percentile query needs the percentile parameter and a supported metric.
Do not average percentages from unequal populations or add bucketed unique-user counts to obtain a period total. Retain the definition and population.

blocks.text: If you use the local aggregate panel
The local Bitmovin Analytics (server-proxied query) panel offers these four fixed aggregates. Follow Analytics API queries for setup, credentials and execution.

rows: Impression/session count; not automatically the dashboard Plays metric.
Intent to play to the first frame; milliseconds (ms).
Average buffering duration; milliseconds (ms), not a percentage.

blocks.text: Local startup measures SourceLoaded to Playing. VIDEO_STARTUPTIME measures playback initiation to the first frame; STARTUPTIME also includes Player setup. Equal units do not make the measurements interchangeable.

items.label: Use the local panel and Query API

blocks.text: Keep names, units and populations together

Keep REST attributes such as VIDEO_STARTUPTIME in their documented uppercase form. Observability MCP uses keywords such as video_startuptime and plays and may add metric-specific conditions. Resolve them with searchMetrics when available, or getAvailableMetrics.
MCP error_percentage differs from error_ratio, which is normalized by viewing hours. Neither is the browser’s Error event count. Check definitions, units and denominators before deriving a rate.
